items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: I went with Shillen's band. Shillen got a band.

ctx.x: People told me when you played on Canal Street, they could hear you over and out.
So that went on, and so I went with Shillen's band. Shillen got a band.
A little bit more about Fisher's Band. What kind of music did they play? Marches or Ragtime? All Ragtime. Ragtime. Can you remember some of the pieces they played? Oh.
